data.precedent_hint:
---
PROVEN PRECEDENT — a similar change already shipped in this codebase ('rework-legal-rework-noop-reroute-model-keys-mock-darwin-live-model-env-g-39a0695'). ADAPT this known-good pattern (files touched, structure, conventions) instead of inventing from scratch; do not copy blindly:
```diff
commit 2abd081cc240726ab5596d21b65d777052af86b5
Author: Kale Aaron Pasch <kalepasch@gmail.com>
Date:   Wed Jul 8 19:53:10 2026 -0400

    fix(vercel): correct framework id (nuxt -> nuxtjs), drop invalid nodeVersion key, skip agent/recovery branch builds
    
    Production deploys have been instant-failing (0ms, before build starts) because
    vercel.json declared framework: "nuxt", which is not a valid Vercel framework
    preset (the correct id is "nuxtjs") -- Vercel rejected every deploy at the
    config-validation stage before a build ever ran. It also declared a top-level
    nodeVersion key, which Vercel's schema does not allow there.
    
    Verified: vercel --prod now builds and deploys successfully (Ready in ~1m)
    after this fix.
    
    Also adds ignoreCommand to skip preview builds for agent/*, recover*, rework*
    branches per the fleet's two-Mac branch-share change -- those now push to
    origin and were burning preview build slots.
---
 vercel.json | 4 ++--
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/vercel.json b/vercel.json
index d4674a4..5f492cb 100644
--- a/vercel.json
+++ b/vercel.json
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 {
   "buildCommand": "npm run build",
-  "framework": "nuxt",
-  "nodeVersion": "20.x"
+  "framework": "nuxtjs",
+  "ignoreCommand": "bash -c 'case \"$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF\" in agent/*|recover*|rework*) exit 0;; *) exit 1;; esac'"
 }

```
